zara (pm): Putting this here so we don't lose the decision logic: customers ask for predictable isolation + clear price/latency tradeoffs. We need a decision ladder (what to ship first, how to price, how to cutover).

vik (eng-plat): Suggestion: build a decision ladder doc with 4 columns: capability, acceptance signal, cost delta, rollback action. Start with soft-affinity (low cost) -> reserved reservations -> dedicated pools -> private control plane.

drew (infra): Important infra note: reserved reservations can be implemented as (A) strict dedicated pools or (B) reservation tokens on shared pools. A is simpler for SLO guarantees, B saves money. We should price both options.

mel (sre): Ops items: define chaos scenario for each rung on ladder. Example: for reservation tokens, simulate 30% sudden traffic doubling and assert eviction has <0.5% user error spike and p99 < threshold.

dina (sales): Sales wants short explainer: "What you pay buys you what guarantee". Need a table mapping price multiplier -> expected p95/p99 improvements and a migration credit option.

vik (eng-plat): Minimal API sketch for ladder entry:
```
ladder.add({
  name: "reserved-token",
  cost_multiplier: 2.1,
  guarantees: {p95: 120, p99: 320},
  rollback: "revoke-token-fallthrough"
})
```
We also need telemetry event: policy.change and fallback.trigger with context (tenant_id, old_lane, new_lane, fallback_model).

zara (pm): Acceptance signals per rung (short):
- soft-affinity: metric: cross-region spill < 5% of requests; perf: p95 < 150ms in perf harness; rollout: 5% canary for 24h.
- reserved-token: billing hooks enforce quota within 60s; perf: p95 < 130ms; chaos: eviction scenario validated.
- dedicated-pool: canary tenant on dedicated pool for 72h with SLA reports; budget commits signed.
- private: install runbook verified, KMS integration, audit logs present.

mel (sre): I'll create the chaos matrix and the abort criteria for each rung. Plan to include automated smoke runs as part of the canary.

drew (infra): Cost modeling: will produce two numbers per tenant profile: steady-state monthly and burst cost. We'll include a suggested warm-buffer SKU to reduce cold-start penalties.

dina (sales): I'll draft the one-pager and the migration credit offer. Also will coordinate with FinTrust pilot timelines.

telemetry-bot: Note recorded: new event spec request: fallback.trigger (tenant_id, fallback_model, latency_ms, region). File added to /specs/telemetry/2955559999.

vik (eng-plat): Dependencies: research (compatibility matrix), runtime (warm-start API), infra (pool allocator + cost sim), billing (quota enforcement), console (ladder UI + estimator). Assign owners in the doc.

zara (pm): Next actions: I'll draft the decision ladder doc and PR it. Review deadline Tue EOD. Ping me for any blocker.

mel (sre): One more ops ask: include an SLA delta calculator so legal can see contract language.

zara (pm): Added. Thanks all.
